reviewer: Separate adapter/security/evidence reviewer; independent of evaluator author
reviewScope: Harness-only failed-turn evidence retention in agent.go and three meaningful agent_test.go regressions; no product changes, model inference or raw-answer edits performed by reviewer.

findings.detail: Unknown turn status is normalized in both failed row and retained turn/completed event; failed/interrupted statuses retain their meaning. Provider error payloads are replaced with a presence marker, with safe partial answer/tool/HTTP evidence preserved.

prepareAgentCall preserves launched timeout/capture call IDs, commands, bounded partial outputs, duration, exit/signal and captureLimitHit before propagating Execute error. A zero unstarted result is excluded. Native process instrumentation remains independent.

persistAgentObservation appends a failed observation and recalculates condition aggregates from all retained observations, writes the report, then returns the session error. Write failure takes precedence and is tested using a regular-file parent directory. A noncompleted turn with nil underlying error receives a clear nonnil failure result.

securityAndEvidenceAssessment: Filesystem isolation, credential placement outside the agent mount, tool restrictions, aggregate protocol and tool capture ceilings, read-only checks and process cleanup are unchanged.
Failed status never upgrades to completed or a passing task grade. Failed observations include available costs, rather than becoming zero-cost omitted rows.
Output metrics and final-answer canary flags are calculated before PortableReport scrubbing; no raw provider failure text is newly published.
The normal completed-session event and returned-call shape remain unchanged; completed trace preservation, tool roundtrip and timeout cleanup regressions pass.
Only the new harness digest binds future evaluation runs; the ten-row first attempt retains its original digest and missing failed-session trace is explicitly disclosed.

lsp.fallback: Focused Go compilation/tests with race detector

focusedRace.scope: Reviewer-run focused checks, separate from parent full evaluation race suite

limitations: This correction does not reconstruct the unrecorded eleventh session of the first attempt.
Pre-turn setup, metrics/scrubbing or filesystem-write failures still fail explicitly and may not produce a new session row; they cannot be claimed as successful evaluation.
Durable report means the write completes before failure returns; it does not claim fsync crash durability or atomic file replacement.
The focused review does not replace the required fresh full sixteen-session paired run and independent answer/full-trace grading.
